instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope. Seja explícito pra que ele não gere com textos no envelope, pois a referência é apenas para cores e elementos.
prompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious elegant envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope is handcrafted, premium and refined, with realistic paper texture, soft matte finish, subtle fibers, clean precise folds and crisp geometry. The design is elegant and minimal, using a sophisticated palette of red, white and silver, with refined metallic accents, pearlescent highlights and tasteful ornamental details. Wax seal, ribbon, emblem or closure elements are finely detailed, tactile and luxurious, but the envelope must remain clean and uncluttered.

**Important: the envelope must be completely blank, with no text, no letters, no words, no typography, no logos, no symbols resembling writing, and no printed address or calligraphy.** The reference is only for colors and decorative elements, not for any text content.

The envelope is placed within a rich, story-driven environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms an elegant narrative scene with soft blur but recognizable depth, such as a refined ceremonial setting, a romantic nocturnal interior, or a luxurious decorative space with tasteful architecture and subtle floral accents. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including delicate petals, silver sparkles, soft glowing particles, and elegant floral details, arranged organically around the envelope to enhance motion and sophistication without overpowering the composition.

Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and subtle volumetric light rays creating depth and atmosphere. Gentle haze and floating particles catch the light, producing a premium, dreamy, elegant mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is harmonious and intentional, dominated by red, white and silver, with luminous highlights, smooth gradients and controlled contrast.

Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture, seal and ornamental details, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic realism, elegant luxury aesthetic, refined and premium. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, sophisticated, visually striking, suitable for premium elegant invitations and luxury visual concepts.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a blank decorative sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame, but still allowing visible space around the edges to reveal the floor, background, and side elements. The sheet feels premium, elegant and refined, with realistic paper texture, soft matte surface, subtle fibers, clean crisp edges, and a luxurious finish. The paper is centered and dominant, designed as the clear hero of the image, with enough negative space to preserve readability and compositional balance. Ornamental adornments surround the sheet in a tasteful and symmetrical way, including delicate red and silver floral accents, metallic filigree, elegant ribbons, embossed decorative details, fine sparkles, and subtle ornamental flourishes, all arranged organically around the central paper without overwhelming it.

The environment is rich and story-driven, not a flat backdrop. The background suggests an elegant ceremonial setting with softly blurred but recognizable floor textures, refined architectural or decorative side elements, and a sophisticated ambient atmosphere. The scene feels luxurious, polished, and graceful, with contextual depth created by subtle props and elegant surrounding forms. Side elements frame the composition gently, enhancing the central focus on the blank sheet while maintaining visual breathing room.

Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft key light illuminating the paper surface, delicate rim light outlining the edges, and subtle volumetric light rays adding depth and atmosphere. Gentle reflections on the silver ornaments create a premium metallic sheen, while the red accents bring warmth and richness to the composition. Soft shadows are realistic and directional, grounding the paper naturally within the scene. A faint atmospheric haze and floating particles add a dreamy, elegant mood without distracting from the blank surface.

The color palette is intentional and harmonious, based on luxurious red and silver tones, with controlled contrast, luminous highlights, and smooth gradients. The blank sheet remains clean, pristine, and uncluttered, emphasizing elegance and sophistication. Composition: foreground-dominant, paper sharply in focus, surrounding adornments detailed and tactile, background softly defocused, visible floor and lateral elements for spatial context, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: cinematic close-up with a slightly wide framing, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and ornamental details, soft bokeh in the background. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, elegant, premium, editorial luxury aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, refined, visually luxurious, suitable for elegant stationery and high-end design visuals.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Elegante) e na paleta de cores (Vermelho e prata). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "Aniversário Lívia". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Copie ambas literalmente, sem acrescentar idade, data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
